summary.description: One sentence on what the change is for, then the overall assessment and any defect already in the base.

findings.description: The most important findings first, at most ten.

category.description: request: part of the request the change doesn't deliver. tests: a behaviour the change adds that no test pins.

severity.description: high: goes wrong in normal use. medium: goes wrong on an edge case or error path. low: nothing goes wrong today, but a later regression would get through.

evidence.description: What proved it: the command or test run and what it showed, or the code path traced from the entry point to the defect.

doubts.description: What the reviewer suspects but couldn't confirm.

settle.description: What would confirm or rule it out.
